summary.text: Jennifer Gutiérrez represents the 34th District on the New York City Council, which includes Williamsburg, East Williamsburg, Bushwick and Ridgewood, and was first elected in 2021.
Her Council biography says that in her third term she chairs the Subcommittee on Early Childhood Education.

paragraphs.text: Gutiérrez was born and raised in Queens to parents who emigrated from Colombia in the 1980s, and attended New York City public schools, according to her Council biography.
Before her election she worked as a community organizer in Williamsburg with tenants and families facing displacement and eviction, and served as Chief of Staff to Council Member Antonio Reynoso.
During her first two terms she chaired the Committee on Technology, advancing legislation on transparency of artificial intelligence systems used by city agencies and on broadband access.
She is also Co-Vice Chair of the Progressive Caucus, and the biography says her legislative record covers maternal health, childcare, housing stability and industrial businesses.
